verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud lets you start agent runs via the API (`client.runs.create`) that carry out a goal on their own in managed cloud browsers. You then monitor them by polling `runs.events()`. Saved profiles allow repeat runs already logged in, and CAPTCHA solving is automatic, which supports unattended execution in the background. However, the evidence documents only on-demand, API-triggered runs, not set-and-forget automations. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs (cron-style triggers), event-based triggers, completion callbacks instead of polling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation.
